sections.markdown:
The Navy and Marine Corps Safe Sleep Campaign's primary theme is _"Safe Sleep, Strong Families, Mission Ready."_ We want to embed safe sleep practices into the culture of every installation, protecting our youngest family members and enhancing the resilience and readiness of our Marines and Sailors.

Learn more about the ABCs of safe sleep and simple ways to keep babies safe: [Keep Safe Sleep Simple](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/news/safe-sleep-for-babies).
